description.value: Abbey Road Taphouse is a large sports bar and full-service restaurant in Abbotsford with over 55 HD displays, live band weekends, karaoke nights, and UFC pay-per-view events. The kitchen turns out an eclectic menu spanning burgers, pastas, Mexican tacos, breakfast on weekends, and 30-plus wing flavours, alongside 25 beers on tap and what the bar bills as the largest tequila collection in BC. An all-season covered patio operates year-round with heaters, making it a usable stop in variable Fraser Valley weather.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM phone, address (1851 Sumas Way, Abbotsford), and URL. The site confirms an active, open restaurant/sports bar with DoorDash delivery listed, GF-tagged menu items, and a veggie slider option. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'Chilliwack' but the business is located in Abbotsford per both its website ('Abbotsford Restaurant & Sports Bar', '1851 Sumas Way in Abbotsford') and the postal code V2S 4L5. The community tag should be corrected to Abbotsford.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and sports bar with a confirmed website, current events, and full menu. Straightforward include.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly marks several items GF (e.g. Loaded Nachos, Warm Spinach Dip w/corn chips, Shrimp Scampi w/corn chips) and offers a Veggie slider option
